cues.en: Now for the famous attention algorithm.

cues.en: So the results of the equation is the activations.
cues.zh: 方程式的結果是活化值。

cues.en: You can also think of these as adjustments.
cues.zh: 也可以把它們視為調整量。

cues.en: The idea is that this calculation is based on the token embeddings, and the result is an adjustment that is added back onto the token embeddings.
cues.zh: 概念是，這項計算以詞元嵌入為基礎，結果是一個會加回詞元嵌入的調整量。

cues.en: Now maybe that adjustment is a small rotation or scaling of the embeddings vector.

cues.zh: 後面的影片會提到，結果其實不會直接加回嵌入。

cues.en: It gets combined with other calculations before actually being summed back onto the token embeddings
cues.zh: 它會先和其他計算結果結合，才真正加回詞元嵌入

cues.en: vector, but this is part of how the vectors are adjusted.
cues.zh: 向量，但這確實是調整向量方式的一部分。

cues.en: This yellow sigma here is for the softmax function.
cues.zh: 黃色的 sigma 代表 softmax 函數。

cues.en: This q here is called the query matrix.
cues.zh: 這裡的 Q 叫查詢矩陣。

cues.en: K is called the key matrix, and this here is the dimensionality of the k matrix.
cues.zh: K 叫鍵矩陣，這裡則是 K 矩陣的維度。

cues.en: The m here is the causal time mask that you learned about in the previous two videos.
cues.zh: M 是前兩支影片介紹的時間因果遮罩。

cues.en: And V here is called the value matrix.
cues.zh: V 叫值矩陣。

cues.en: This w zero.
cues.zh: 這個 Wₒ，

cues.zh: 則是另一個矩陣，用來對注意力活化結果做線性轉換。

cues.en: I'm including it here for completeness because I will discuss it later, but not for another couple of videos.

cues.zh: 主要是在開始介紹多頭注意力時會出現。

cues.en: Now I can imagine that you have many questions here.
cues.zh: 我想你現在應該有很多問題。

cues.en: For example, what are these query key and value matrices?
cues.zh: 例如，這些查詢、鍵、值矩陣到底是什麼？

cues.en: Why do they appear in this order?
cues.zh: 為什麼以這個順序出現？

cues.en: Why isn't the value matrix part of the softmax transformation?
cues.zh: 為什麼值矩陣不包含在 softmax 轉換內？

cues.en: And why do we scale by the square root of the embeddings size?
cues.zh: 為什麼要除以嵌入大小的平方根來縮放？

cues.en: Well, that last question I can answer right now.
cues.zh: 最後這個問題，現在就能回答。

cues.en: I discussed this a few videos ago.
cues.zh: 前幾支影片已討論過。

cues.en: And basically the variance of this QQ matrix multiplication inflates by a factor corresponding to the square root of the matrix size.
cues.zh: 基本上，這個 Q、K 矩陣乘法的變異數，會依矩陣大小的平方根這個係數擴張。

cues.en: So this is simply a scaling factor to prevent the numbers from getting too big.
cues.zh: 所以這只是避免數字過大的縮放係數。

cues.en: Now for a single head attention layer, which is what we're dealing with here and in the next few videos, the dimensionality of K, it matches the embedding dimensionality.
cues.zh: 單頭注意力層，也就是現在與接下來幾支影片處理的情況中，K 的維度和嵌入維度相同。

cues.en: So 768 for GPT two.
cues.zh: 所以 GPT-2 是 768。

cues.en: In a few videos from now, I'll introduce Multi-head attention, where the Q, K and V matrices are actually split up into smaller blocks.
cues.zh: 再過幾支影片會介紹多頭注意力，Q、K、V 矩陣實際上會拆成較小的區塊。

cues.en: And then d sub k might actually be something like 768 divided by 12, which would be 64, and the 12
cues.zh: 這時 dₖ 可能是 768 除以 12，也就是 64，而 12

cues.en: would correspond to 12 attention heads.
cues.zh: 對應 12 個注意力頭。

cues.en: Okay, I'm now going to present a kind of silly analogy to help you understand what the query key and
cues.zh: 接下來用一個有點傻的比喻，幫助你了解查詢、鍵與

cues.en: value matrices do, but let me preemptively state that all analogies break down when you push them too far.
cues.zh: 值矩陣的作用。但先強調，任何比喻只要過度延伸，都會失準。

cues.en: So don't try to take what I'm going to explain here too Literally.
cues.zh: 所以不要把接下來的說明看得太字面。

cues.en: Okay, so imagine there is a dating app for token embeddings.
cues.zh: 想像有一個專門給詞元嵌入使用的交友軟體。

cues.en: The query vector for a given token is its dating profile, and it's sharing that profile with the other tokens.
cues.zh: 某個詞元的查詢向量，就是它的交友檔案，會分享給其他詞元。

cues.en: So then we have the keys vectors.
cues.zh: 接著有鍵向量。

cues.en: These are the dating profiles of the other tokens in the text.
cues.zh: 這些是文字中其他詞元的交友檔案。

cues.en: The tokens that come before the query token.
cues.zh: 也就是查詢詞元之前的那些詞元。

cues.en: And so they're all checking out each other.
cues.zh: 它們會彼此打量。

cues.en: They're looking at each other's profiles.
cues.zh: 看看彼此的檔案。

cues.en: They want to see if there is a match and how do they calculate if there is a match.
cues.zh: 想知道能不能配對，而要怎麼算是否配對？

cues.en: They dot product.
cues.zh: 做內積。

cues.en: Remember that the dot product is the numerator of cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 記得，內積就是餘弦相似度的分子。

cues.en: So it's kind of like the query vector of the current token is calculating cosine similarity with the keys vectors from all the previous tokens.
cues.zh: 所以有點像目前詞元的查詢向量，與所有先前詞元的鍵向量計算餘弦相似度。

cues.en: I know it's very romantic.
cues.zh: 我知道，非常浪漫。

cues.en: Now there's no normalization in here.
cues.zh: 不過這裡沒有正規化。

cues.en: So this is not formally a cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 所以嚴格來說，不是餘弦相似度。

cues.en: But again, the dot product is kind of like an unscaled cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 但再次強調，內積可以視為未經縮放的餘弦相似度。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Then the softmax comes along and transforms all of these dot products into a probability of the keys and the queries vectors matching.
cues.zh: 接著 softmax 把這些內積，轉成鍵向量與查詢向量配對的機率。

cues.en: Remember that the softmax makes all of these values positive and sum to one.
cues.zh: 記得，softmax 會讓所有值為正，而且總和為 1。

cues.en: And will also exaggerate the largest values while pushing the smaller values down further.
cues.zh: 也會凸顯較大的值，同時進一步壓低較小的值。

cues.en: So now we have probabilities of matches.
cues.zh: 現在就有配對機率了。

cues.en: Then we get the values matrix.
cues.zh: 接著輪到值矩陣。

cues.en: This is kind of like all the other features and properties of the token embeddings that you learn about after a few dates.
cues.zh: 這有點像約會幾次後，你才了解的詞元嵌入其他特徵與性質。

cues.en: So this is like the story of the relationship between q and k.
cues.zh: 就像 Q 和 K 之間的感情故事。

cues.en: So query and key that gets transformed back into the token embeddings and added on to the ongoing saga
cues.zh: 也就是查詢與鍵，經過轉換回到詞元嵌入，再加進這段持續發展的故事，

cues.en: of the transformation of the embeddings vectors from the beginning of the model to the end of the model.
cues.zh: 也就是嵌入向量從模型起點到終點的轉換歷程。

cues.en: Okay, here's the math again so you can see how this lines up.
cues.zh: 好，再看一次數學式，看看彼此如何對應。

cues.en: So again the query is the current processed token.
cues.zh: 再次強調，查詢就是目前處理的詞元，

cues.en: Looking for love with all the other token embeddings.
cues.zh: 正向所有其他詞元嵌入尋找愛情。

cues.en: And the dot product with the keys will be larger when there's a good match between their embeddings
cues.zh: 當嵌入向量彼此配對得好，與鍵的內積

cues.en: vectors, and it will be negative when there isn't a good match between the current process token and all the other tokens.
cues.zh: 就較大；如果目前詞元與其他詞元不太匹配，內積就會是負的。

cues.en: And again.
cues.zh: 同樣地，

cues.en: Then the softmax pushes the best matches to the top and the values provides even more information about the best matching pair.
cues.zh: softmax 會讓最佳配對升到最前面，而值矩陣會提供更多關於最佳配對的資訊。

cues.en: And the time causal mask here ensures that these interactions are only happening between the current token and previous tokens.
cues.zh: 這裡的時間因果遮罩，則確保這些互動只發生在目前詞元與之前詞元之間。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the story.
cues.zh: 故事就是這樣。

cues.zh: 但這些矩陣從哪裡來？

cues.en: Well, you know already how M is calculated.

cues.zh: 矩陣而來。

cues.zh: 先初始化查詢矩陣，
